listingTitle: Rev-A-Shelf 2-Tier Pie-Cut Plastic Lazy Susan for Corner Base Cabinets, 28"
listingLines: Size & Compatibility: Organize your space with our Polymer Pie-Cut Two-Tier Lazy Susan for corner base cabinets. This rotating kitchen organizer measures 28"W x 18.25"D x 26"H.

Check Cabinet Size: Measure the inside height and diameter of your cabinet. Assembly must be completed inside the cabinet with 2" of clearance between the cabinet wall and the unit. Any existing door must be compatible with pie-cut shelves.

How to Install: Pre-drill holes and install the brackets, cam base, shafts and trays inside the cabinet. Attach the trays to the door, then center and secure the door. Fine-tune the height and install the retainer clip. Hardware is included.
Durable & Adjustable Design: This cabinet turntable features durable plastic shelves and an adjustable post that can accommodate an interior height of 26" to 32".

Stylish 360-Degree Access: Our corner cabinet organizer spins 360 degrees for easy access. Use it to store pantry essentials, canned goods and cleaning products while maintaining kitchen organization.
summary: This two-tier rotating organizer is designed to maximize storage in corner base cabinets. It features durable plastic shelves that spin 360 degrees to provide access to pantry essentials, canned goods, and cleaning products.
highlights: Two-tier polymer shelves designed specifically for pie-cut corner cabinets
Adjustable telescoping post fits interior cabinet heights from 26 to 32 inches
Full 360-degree rotation for access to all stored items
Includes necessary hardware for mounting the unit and attaching it to the cabinet door
Shelves measure 28 inches in width and 18.25 inches in depth
bestFor: Corner base cabinets in kitchens or utility rooms
Storing canned goods and pantry staples
Cabinets with doors compatible with pie-cut shelf designs
stylingTips: Group similar items like canned vegetables or baking supplies together to keep the rotation organized.
Place taller cleaning bottles on the top tier if your cabinet height allows for the necessary clearance.
Utilize the white plastic finish to maintain a clean and bright look inside dark corner cabinets.
beforeYouBuy: Measure the inside height and diameter of your cabinet to ensure it fits the 26 to 32 inch adjustable range.
Confirm that your cabinet provides at least 2 inches of clearance between the unit and the cabinet walls.
Verify that your existing cabinet door is compatible with pie-cut shelves as the trays must attach to the door.
